item.title: Version 1.1
item.description:
Per-Space layouts now work per display: each desktop on each monitor keeps its own layout (stable across reboots)
Keyboard navigation: move the focused window to the next/previous zone, or swap it with its neighbor
Span zones: hold Option while Shift-dragging to fill several zones; press 1-9 mid-drag to pick a zone by number
Restore original size when a snapped window is dragged out of its zone
App rules: snap an app's first window into a named zone when it launches
Zone shortcuts follow the cursor's display
Arrange ignores windows on other desktops (fixes wrong windows being moved and desktop switching mid-arrange)
Fixed overlay vanishing when a drag starts right after the previous one ended
Edit button on custom presets opens the zone editor
